descriptions.zh:
在最近我们涉足太空的那一刻起，对我们起源的不同看法很快变成了一场大分裂。极端主义团体很快吸纳了更多的克隆人，我们牢固的联盟破裂了。

有些人将创造者视为要崇拜和遵从的神，并相信我们是按照祂们的形象创造的。他们坚决维持现状。其他人则诅咒我们先祖的行为，称他们为“奴隶贩子”，相信他们一定会遭到报应。

一个设立于[clone_digsite_planet.GetName]的发掘遗址将会验证真相，平息所有的争论。在我们将视线投降太空中之前，我们必须穷尽现有的全部可能性。我们的国家很古老，无数克隆人世世代代生活于此。在我们母星的远古建筑之下，一定存在明显的线索在等待着我们。
descriptions.en:
With our recent arrival into space, the differing views on our origin are rapidly turning into a schism. Extremist groups are rapidly attracting more clones. Our strong unity is broken.

Some view the Creators as gods to be worshiped and obeyed, and believe we were made in their image. They would do nothing except maintain the status quo. Others curse our ancient masters for their actions, labeling them 'slavers,' and would see them repaid in full.

An excavation site has been established on [clone_digsite_planet.GetName] to verify the facts and put the debate to rest. Before we turn to space, we should exhaust all immediate possibilities. Our nation is old. Many generations of clones lived and died here. Beneath the ancient structures of our homeworld, some significant clues are bound to be waiting for us.

descriptions.zh:
从一个核心发掘遗址中我们成功地确定了其中一座§Y远古克隆仓§!的年代，通过分析建筑下方的土层结构，将其密度和组成与周围其他的土壤进行对比，从而可以得出这座建筑可靠的建立年代。

几乎可以确定，我们中的第一个，也就是第一个克隆人，是在大约距今12个世纪之前被制造出来的。

无数世代的历史都因漠不关心而被淡忘。即便到今日我们也已经错过了许多事情，也许其中就有值得我们现在惋惜的。
descriptions.en:
A central dig site has managed to successfully date the installation of one of our §YAncient Clone Vats§! by analyzing the soil beneath the structure - comparing its density and composition to that of its surroundings - and we have reached a reasonable estimate of when it was placed there.

It appears the first of our kind, the first clones, were produced approximately twelve centuries ago.

Many generations of history have been lost to apathy. Much has passed us by, and perhaps that is something to regret.

descriptions.zh:
其中一个发掘遗址报告了一个最近发现的，长得像[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的化石。它非常古老。这些化石被发现在一处远古住所的附近。显然，那些化石和建筑都比§Y远古克隆仓§!的建造要早上数百万年的时间。

初步的基因测序确认了这些化石的主人与我们在基因序列上的显著相似性，可以得出结论，这些遗留物属于我们的祖先，并且远早于我们开始被克隆的年代。

事情变得明朗起来
descriptions.en:
One of the excavation sites has reported the discovery of old, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]-like fossils. Very old fossils. They were found in and around remnants of what is presumed to be primitive homesteads. Apparently, both the fossils and architecture predate the construction of our §YAncient Clone Vats§! by more than a millennium.

Initial DNA sequencing has confirmed significant similarities between our genetic make-up and that of the fossilized matter, and it has been concluded that the remains belong to our ancient predecessors, from before we were clones.

This puts things into perspective.

tooltips.zh: 这些发现仍需要一段时间的深入研究……
tooltips.en: These findings will take a while to sink in...

descriptions.zh:
发掘遗址传出证实我们的物种曾是 [Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的原始人的这一新闻很快就传播开了。

很难否认这一明显的结论：对像我们的先祖这样已经适应了战争的原始物种进行基因修饰是有明确的目的的。我们的创造者改造了我们，让我们为他们流血牺牲。他们将我们提升以满足他们的私欲，而完全不考虑我们的利益。

这真的是我们想要告诉人民的历史吗？

现在还有机会篡写我们自己的历史。
descriptions.en:
News of the excavation findings, proving that our species was once a primitive people on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], is beginning to spread.

It is difficult to deny the obvious conclusion: genetically modifying a primitive species such as our forebears - a species already suited to wage war - serves a specific purpose. Our Creators remade us to die for their cause. They uplifted us to fulfill their needs, never to prosper on our own terms.

Is this really the history we want for our people?

There is ample opportunity to rewrite our past.

label.zh: 是的，我们就是创造者自己的克隆体。
label.en: Yes, we were made in the image of the Creators.

descriptions.zh:
数年前，考古发掘工作发现了我们被创造出来的意义。现实是残酷的：我们被创造出来的目的是被奴役，并为我们的创造者战死。我们选择向人民撒一个善意的谎言，以免他们被这一事实摧垮。

通过煞费苦心的恢复被删除的考古档案，一位克隆人颠覆性地公开了我们试图掩盖的事实。

这位尚未找到的告密者至少没有扭曲事实或者添油加醋。

嗨呀，看来再也没有必要冒着让人民对我们的领导失望的风险这么做，这条新闻很快就终结了我们关于辉煌过去编造的那条谎言：我们是创造者的克隆体，与创造者是平等的而非他们的奴隶。
descriptions.en:
Years back, excavations were made to find the purpose of our creation. The learnings were hard: we were made to serve, to die in the name of our Creators. We chose to guard our people from that truth by giving them a better one.

By painstakingly recovering deleted files from those excavations, a subversive clone has made public knowledge of the facts we concealed.

The still-unknown culprit has, at least, not twisted the information or added to it in any way.

Alas, it appears there was no need to, as the news has swiftly ended the belief in our glorious past - that we were made in the image of the Creators, equals rather than slaves - and replaced it with a disappointment in leadership.

tooltips.en: Offer a public apology to the [Root.Owner.GetAdjective] people.

descriptions.zh:
一条精心编辑的视频信息被公开，解释了编造故事背后的良苦用心。这份广播解释这个谎言是出于善意，但同时强调我们真实的过往并不可耻，我们应该更多地放眼未来。还不忘提醒散播这一善意的谎言也给大家带来过巨大的好处。

这条信息似乎非常能被公众接受，尽管很难说这个以外还会带来什么后续的负面影响。但无论如何，损失的影响力会随着时间平复，而这一事件也会逐渐平息。
descriptions.en:
A carefully constructed video message has been sent out, explaining the reasons behind the manufactured story. The broadcast explains that it was meant as a kindness, emphasizing that there is no shame in our true past and that we must look to the future. Mention is also given to the significant advances we have made since propagating such false beliefs.

The message appears to have been well received, although it is hard to say what blemishes these incidents might leave behind. In any case, the influence lost will be recovered over time, and the issue has otherwise been laid to rest.

descriptions.zh:
一众高阶军官最近出现在公众视野中，表达了对于我们主流思潮的支持。

在一段广为告知的信息中，他们对我们那种坦诚我们的过去，向[Root.GetAdjective]的人民及他们的信仰的勇气和智慧致敬。信仰因我们准备好面对过去而得到加强，并使其能够勇敢地面对未来。

各地的人们都在一致庆祝，称赞做出的决定。
descriptions.en:
A number of high-ranking officers have taken it upon themselves to publicly acknowledge their approval of our leadership ethics.

In a widely broadcasted message, they salute the bravery and wisdom it took to be truthful about our past, and the faith shown in them and the [Root.GetAdjective] people. They are strengthened by our readiness to face the past and it has allowed them to face the future with courage.

People all over are celebrating in agreement, praising the decision that was made.

options.script:
name = ASTOUNDING
add_modifier = { modifier = honorable_leadership days = 3600 }

descriptions.zh:
据信我们曾一度具有自由繁殖的能力。

然而，即便在我们母星上其他的生物上的实验有所进展，但让我们重获这项能力的实验此前从未成功。进展停滞了非常长的时间，直到现在。

一个不太可能的发现带给我们的科学家希望：一段隐藏在§Y远古克隆仓§!中的量子生物编码中的密码处于一个据信用于调控我们基因组可育能力的区段。
descriptions.en:
It is thought that we were once capable of independent reproduction.

However, experiments to reclaim that capability have consistently failed, including those successful on other creatures of our homeworld. Progress has for a long time been at a standstill, until now.

An unlikely discovery has our scientists hopeful: a cipher, hidden in the quantum bio-code of the §YAncient Clone Vats§!, in an area believed to govern our genome's potential for procreation.

descriptions.zh:
我们科学家不屈不挠的尝试下，远古克隆仓中的密码终于被攻破。尽管存在协议，极度的渴望驱仍使着科学专员去激活了他们得到的密码。

一个来自过去的回声出现在屏幕上……
descriptions.en:
By the tenacity of our scientists, the cipher found within the Ancient Clone Vats has been decoded. Protocol notwithstanding, the overly eager lead science officer has activated the key it contained.

A message from the past echoes on the screen...

options.script:
name = PROCEED
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = clones.21 } }

descriptions.zh:
“我罪孽深重。我无法想象是怎么走到今天这地步的，不过肯定不是我同党们的仁慈。”

我为创造你们来服役效了力，为此我感到非常抱歉。我已经对事态的发展无力回天，不过我可以帮助你们开启未来。虽然你们值得有更多的选择，但我只有能力为你们指明两条道路：

理解你们被绝育的关键因素，然后获得演化和繁育的自由。

或者进一步解锁你们的潜质，但把基因困死于牢笼，让子子孙孙永远受限于克隆科技。
descriptions.en:
"I am burdened by guilt. I cannot imagine what paths have led to this, but surely not the mercy of my brethren.

I helped create you to serve, and for that I am sorry. I cannot take back what is done, but I can help to open your future. Although you are deserving of more, I offer you two paths:

To undo the changes that made you sterile, and finally set you free to evolve and prosper.

To further unlock your potential, but strain your genes to their limits, sealing future generations to forever be dependent on technology for reproduction."

descriptions.zh:
我们的繁育能力恢复了，第一批新的§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!看到了这一天黎明的曙光。他们和他们的子孙将永远地改变整个种族的未来，我们的社会也要为之改变去适应变化。

对§Y远古克隆仓§!的需求已经是过去式，已通过决议拆解所有的克隆仓以寻找是否有更多值得研究的东西，其余的则会被回收利用。
descriptions.en:
Our fertility is reclaimed, and the first batch of the new §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! has seen the light of the day. They will forever change our future with children of their own, forcing our society to change and adapt with them.

The need for the §YAncient Clone Vats§! is past, and a decision has been made to strip them of anything that can be researched further. What is left will be recycled and put to use elsewhere.

descriptions.zh:
我们何必拒绝唾手可得的力量？我们不需要对创造者的爱都能体会到他们选择我们的是多么明智。远古克隆仓也是强大的礼物。

当然要接受我们的力量，当第一批§Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!准备就绪时，我们就会变得比以往任何时候更加强大。我们完美的种族定会繁荣昌盛。
descriptions.en:
Why should we deny the strength we have been given? We need not love the Creators to recognize their wisdom in choosing us. The Ancient Clone Vats, too, are a powerful gift.

It is better to embrace our strength, and with the first batch of §Y[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! completed, we are stronger than ever before. Our perfected species shall prosper.
